entry.summary: No visa for stays up to 180 days a year.
entry.max_stay: 180 days a year; longer needs a resident card (up to 30 days to process)

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Armenian Dram (AMD). Strict rules apply to importing and exporting cash amounts of USD 10,000 or over (or equivalent). US dollars and euros can be exchanged at banks. ATMs and credit card facilities are available in Yerevan but are less common outside major towns.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe. They include long prison sentences.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Always carry a copy of your passport. Police can stop you to check your documents. It's illegal to take photos of: government or military sites monuments officers in uniform
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: To drive, you need both: a valid International Driving Permit (IDP) a valid Australian driver's licence (digital driver’s licences may not be accepted) Get your IDP before you leave Australia. Driving without an IDP could void your travel and vehicle insurance.
laws.heading: Driving permit

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: April, May and June. Driest: January, February and December. Hottest: July (20.8°C average). Coolest: January (-6.6°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.
